text:
amanda: Quick thread 1 on typed errors & UX for SDKs. We still have divergence on which field to show in sample apps (`message` vs `user_message`) and how SDKs decide to retry. Can we standardize a tiny contract that is obvious to implement?
jason: Proposal: default compact response (production) + verbose opt-in via header `X-Error-Detail: verbose`. Compact includes `code` and `status` (and `retry_after` if relevant). Verbose adds `message`, `user_message`, `user_action`, `retryable`, `retry_hint`, `meta/docs_url`.
priya: For `code` use dot-namespaced values: e.g., `auth.token_expired`, `rate_limit.exceeded`. It's easier for sample app copy and docs linking.
ben: Add `user_action` as canonical string (e.g., `refresh_token`, `sign_in`, `contact_support`) so SDKs and the UI map to the right CTA without custom heuristics.
emily: UX rule: sample apps always display `user_message` (<=140 chars). Show `message` in a collapsible details only when verbose. That avoids scaring new users with internal traces.
jason: Runtime mapping rules: if `retryable` boolean is present, SDK honors it. If absent, SDK uses HTTP fallback: 429 -> retryable=true; 5xx -> retryable=true; 4xx -> retryable=false (except 409 merge conflicts maybe considered retryable depending on `retry_hint`). We'll document edge cases.
priya: Example verbose payload for docs: {
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limit.exceeded",
    "status": 429,
    "message": "Exceeded 100 reqs/min for key abcdef",
    "user_message": "Too many requests. Try again in a few seconds.",
    "user_action": "wait_retry",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 8,
    "retry_hint": "backoff",
    "meta": {"docs_url": "https://redwood.ai/errors#rate_limit.exceeded"}
  }
}
amanda: Compact equivalent: {"error":{"code":"rate_limit.exceeded","status":429,"retry_after":8}}. Good for mobile.
ben: SDKs should expose typed exceptions (e.g., RateLimitError) with properties: code,status,user_message,retry_after,retryable,user_action,docs_url and a helper `.shouldRetry()` implementing the fallback rules but overridable.
jason: Add a parity test harness: canonical responses + expected typed class + `.shouldRetry()` boolean. We'll run it across go/py/js/ruby.
emily: Sample-app note: map `user_action` -> CTA text in a small table in DevEx docs. e.g., `refresh_token` -> "Sign in", `wait_retry` -> "Retry", `contact_support` -> "Contact support".
ci-bot: CI: sdk-go parity test failed in sample-apps/test-suite (error-shape) https://ci.redwood.internal/7777
priya: I'll open the API PR to add `user_message`, `user_action`, and `retryable` fields and the `X-Error-Detail` opt-in header. Tagging @jason and @ben for reviews.
jason: I'll add the HTTP->retry mapping tests to the parity harness.
amanda: Goal: land API contract + example payloads this week, get one SDK green next sprint. Keep any ambiguous cases (e.g., 409) in comments on the PR.
emily: I'll update sample app to read `user_action` and render CTAs accordingly, with a details expander controlled by verbose header.
ben: Small impl note: prefer `retry_after` as integer seconds, null when absent. Avoid sub-second decimals to keep SDK parsing simple.
amanda: Great. Action items summarized: 1) API PR (priory high) to add fields + header; 2) DevEx: example payloads, CTA mapping, parity harness entries; 3) SDKs: typed exceptions + `.shouldRetry()` + compact/verbose handling.
priya: PR draft in progress, will ping for reviews.
jason: will get parity matrix in CI.
amanda: Thanks everyone. Let's aim to close in two sprints. :rocket:
